research_question: Can repeated cross-market quarter-hour order-flow agreement identify a persistent information-driven initiative whose later independent five-minute auction legs are tradable after realistic costs?

external: Kim and Hansen (2026), The Quarter-Hour Effect, arXiv:2607.09426: quarter-hour order imbalance forecasts returns over four to twelve hours, while finer clock frequencies are weaker.
Huth and Abergel (2011), High Frequency Lead/Lag Relationships: naive market-order exploitation is eliminated by the bid/ask spread.
Jia et al. (2023), A Seesaw Effect in the Cryptocurrency Market: large-coin lead-lag can be negative rather than equity-like positive continuation.
internal: V9 generated 143 trades over 42 exposed days, so occurrence frequency was not the bottleneck.
After excluding only six exact unprotected child-stop-rejection episodes, the QH route had 126 trades, 42 wins, 84 losses, 33.33% win rate and negative realized PnL.
V9 trades ending within five minutes had 23.33% win rate and -80,824.14 USDT realized PnL, while the 16-60 minute group was the only positive duration band.

hypothesis.pattern_detector: At each UTC quarter-hour, observe the first completed five-minute interval. A common-flow event exists only when at least three of BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP have the same directional body, inherited displacement magnitude and same-signed taker flow.
hypothesis.state_transition: The first common-flow event is only a candidate. A later distinct quarter-hour event in the same direction, before any opposite common-flow event, confirms persistence and activates a market initiative. An opposite event resets the candidate and terminates any active opposite initiative.
hypothesis.initiative_horizon: Four hours from the confirming event, matching the shortest externally reported predictive horizon. A same-direction fresh event may refresh the observable state; expiry is never extended beyond four hours from the newest confirmation.
hypothesis.invalidation: At a completed five-minute boundary, a majority of the latest accepted markets closing back through their confirming impulse origins terminates the initiative. Clock expiry or an opposite common-flow event also terminates it.
hypothesis.trading_scenario: The periodic event itself is not traded. After initiative activation, each market must independently complete a fresh five-minute market-structure break, directional displacement, strict three-candle FVG and passive first consequent-encroachment retracement.
hypothesis.entry: Post-only limit at the fresh FVG consequent encroachment. The information owner is not privileged or excluded once it forms its own independent post-activation auction leg.
hypothesis.stop: Beyond the last opposing five-minute candle or protected swing plus the inherited ATR buffer. Entry, invalidation and target belong to the same post-activation leg.
hypothesis.target: Next causally confirmed live external 4H or previous-day liquidity pool in the initiative direction.
hypothesis.execution_safety: If a contingent protective order is denied or rejected after a parent fill, cancel remaining orders and flatten the residual position immediately. The event remains an implementation/evidence failure and cannot pass the safety gate.
hypothesis.independence: One plan per distinct post-activation five-minute displacement identity. All core and V10 plans compete through the unchanged one-slot GlobalCandidateMutex.

selection.method: The same six already-exposed V9 diagnostic weeks are reused only to redesign and reject the mechanism. They can never support a success claim.

claim_rules: E01-E06 are exposed development periods and cannot support a success claim.
V10 changes the market-state transition and economic horizon; it does not select a V9 outcome subset or loosen a threshold.
Passing only advances the unchanged mechanism to a broader exposed screen, then a source freeze and untouched continuous validation.
